native.scope: Four bare cardinal real paid construction jobs; draw/held/stow power and door holds; repeated power loss during held return. Frozen paid progress/contact, sparks off, normal completion once.

continue.scope: Fresh disk Continue: North partial exit, East neutral hold, South partial return. Exact paused actor/source/playback/work/clock, no second charge, completion once. Not all facing/phase combinations.

safety.scope: Real South partial retraction: removed order, death, critical flooding. Normal safety clears motion; death renderer pre-update cannot retain stale torch. Not all hazard/gear/path combinations.

sourcePaths.scope: Exact whole-RGBA entry/idle/reversed return/re-interrupted return seams for all348 selected bare torch source indices. Admission corruption checks use actual saved partial exit. Source-path algebra, not native gameplay coverage of all348 phases.
